subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

NATIVE
solution:
The correct answer is 'Alien'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Native **is an adjective which refers to the indigenous inhabitants of a place.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Resident - a person who lives somewhere permanently or on a long-term basis.
 
• Heavenly - of heaven; divine.
 
• Free - able to act or be done as one wishes; not under the control of another.
 
• Alien - belonging to a foreign country.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that alien is the correct antonym for the word native. 
 
• Thus, option 4 is the correct answer.
